# OSD Apparels

> OSD Apparels is an apparel manufacturer and garment exporter in Faisalabad, Punjab, Pakistan, serving private label brands and international buyers.

OSD Apparels supports knitted and woven garments, sampling, custom branding, production, and shipping arrangements. Minimum order starts at 30 pieces. Confirm the quantity breakdown for your design, colours and sizes when requesting a quote.

## Company

- [Home](https://www.osdapparels.com/): Custom clothing manufacturing and export overview.
- [About](https://www.osdapparels.com/about): Company background and manufacturing approach.
- [Contact](https://www.osdapparels.com/contact): Enquiries and current contact details.
- [Reviews](https://www.osdapparels.com/testimonials): Published client testimonials.

## Products and services

- [Products](https://www.osdapparels.com/products): Knitted and woven apparel categories.
- [Menswear](https://www.osdapparels.com/products/mens): Shirts, hoodies, jackets, denim, co-ord sets, activewear, and loungewear.
- [Custom hoodies](https://www.osdapparels.com/products/hoodies): Custom hoodie manufacturing in Faisalabad with fabric, fit, decoration, labels and packaging options.
- [Custom T-shirts](https://www.osdapparels.com/products/t-shirts): Custom T-shirt manufacturing in Faisalabad with fabric, fit, decoration, labels and packaging options.
- [Kidswear](https://www.osdapparels.com/products/kids): Children's clothing, school uniforms, activewear, and matching sets.
- [Services](https://www.osdapparels.com/services): Custom apparel manufacturing, sampling, and export support.
- [Custom orders](https://www.osdapparels.com/custom-order): Private label and OEM development, printing, embroidery, sizing, and packaging.
- [How it works](https://www.osdapparels.com/how-it-works): Enquiry, sampling, production, quality control, and delivery.
- [Request a quote](https://www.osdapparels.com/quote): Submit manufacturing requirements.
